name: Sarah
source:
Hobbies: Swordsmanship practice
Likes: Children
Dream: Establishing an orphanage

Entourage of King of Pangea and the current leader of the resistance. When Sarah was little, she had been abandoned by her family, afterward was picked up and raised by the King of Pangea. Sarah is quite strong-willed, despite looking strict at first glance, she actually has a feminine demeanor. Perhaps because of her circumstances in the past, Sarah is fond of children.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20010123102900/http://www.web-giga.com/seihin/win_pure/p_sarah.htm]official website[/url].]
